Tipping Study - pt.6 GAM modeling of trajectory x-component
---

```{r}
if (!requireNamespace("here")) install.packages("here")
source(here::here("r", "utilities", "workspace.r"))

library(data.table)
library(mgcv)
library(emmeans)

load(here::here("data", "proc", "05_out.rdata"))
```

---

### Set contrasts

```{r}
model_data$effector_side <- relevel(
  model_data$effector_side,
  ref = "Palmar"
)
model_data$left_right_hand <- relevel(
  model_data$left_right_hand,
  ref = "Right Hand"
)
model_data$distractor_effector <- relevel(
  model_data$distractor_effector,
  ref = "Opposite"
)
```

### Define & run model

> [!Note]

Attempts to fit a hierarchical model all failed do to memory constraints.
Alternatively, I might not know what I am doing.

```{r}
formula_m1 <- pos_x ~
  distractor_effector * effector_side * left_right_hand +
  s(index) + # nolint: indentation_linter.
  s(participant_id, bs = "re") +
  s(left_right_hand, bs = "re") +
  s(distractor_effector, bs = "re") +
  s(effector_side, bs = "re")
```

```{r}
m1 <- gam(formula_m1, data = model_data)
```

---

```{r}
save(m1, file = here::here("data", "proc", "06_out.rdata"))
```
